SELECT cs.id, cs.name, cs.source_type, cs.source_url, cs.config, c.slug as category_slug
FROM content_sources cs
JOIN categories c ON cs.category_id = c.id
WHERE cs.source_type IN ('api', 'arxiv', 'pubmed')
AND cs.is_active = TRUE
AND (cs.last_fetch_at IS NULL OR cs.last_fetch_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day')
ORDER BY cs.last_fetch_at NULLS FIRST;
=SELECT id FROM content WHERE external_id = '{{$json.externalId}}' AND source = '{{$json.source}}' LIMIT 1;
=SELECT id FROM categories WHERE slug = '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.categorySlug}}' LIMIT 1;

=INSERT INTO content (
  external_id, content_type, source, category_id,
  title, description, url, thumbnail_url, author,
  published_at, word_count, language, metadata,
  quality_score, popularity_score
) VALUES (
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.externalId}}',
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.contentType}}',
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.source}}',
  '{{$json.id}}',
  $${{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.title.replace(/'/g, "''")}}$$,
  $${{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.description.replace(/'/g, "''")}}$$,
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.url}}',
  {{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.thumbnailUrl ? "'" + $node['Merge All Papers'].json.thumbnailUrl + "'" : 'NULL'}},
  $${{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.author.replace(/'/g, "''")}}$$,
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.publishedAt}}',
  {{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.wordCount}},
  '{{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.language}}',
  '{{JSON.stringify($node['Merge All Papers'].json.metadata).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb,
  {{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.qualityScore}},
  {{$node['Merge All Papers'].json.popularityScore}}
)
RETURNING id, title;

=WITH tag_ids AS (
  SELECT id, slug FROM tags WHERE slug = ANY(ARRAY[{{$json.tags.map(t => "'" + t + "'").join(',')}}])
)
INSERT INTO content_tags (content_id, tag_id)
SELECT '{{$json.contentId}}', id FROM tag_ids
ON CONFLICT (content_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING *;
=UPDATE content_sources SET last_fetch_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{$node['Fetch Active Sources'].json.id}}';

=INSERT INTO workflow_executions (workflow_name, executed_at, status, summary)
VALUES (
  '{{$json.workflow}}',
  '{{$json.executedAt}}',
  'success',
  '{{JSON.stringify($json.stats).replace(/'/g, "''")}}'::jsonb
);

=INSERT INTO workflow_executions (workflow_name, executed_at, status, error_message)
VALUES (

  'failed',
  $${{$json.message.replace(/'/g, "''")}}$$
